      public void runBotTask(StartBotTaskRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<BotTaskEvent> responseObserver)
      Description copied from interface: BotTaskServiceGrpc.AsyncService
      Starts a task and keeps ownership attached to this streaming RPC.
CANCEL_WITH_CALL tasks are cancelled when the stream is cancelled.
CONTINUE tasks remain active and can be reattached with WatchBotTask.
